_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: The overwhelming majority of cash we generate is supported by multi-year fee-based customer arrangements and therefore is not directly exposed to commodity prices. Risk factor: A sharp decline in the prices of oil, NGL or natural gas, or a prolonged unfavorable price environment, would result in a commensurate reduction in our revenues, income and cash flows from our businesses that produce, process, or purchase and sell oil, NGL, or natural gas, and could have a material adverse effect on the carrying value of our CO2 business segment’s proved reserves.; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the CO2 segment owns working interests in oil fields and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Kinder Morgan

theme_watch.reason: Live: Kinder Morgan's own FY2016 10-K says 'We own approximately 97% working interest in the SACROC unit, an approximately 50% working interest in the Yates unit, an approximately 99% working interest in the Katz unit and a 99% working interest in the Goldsmith Landreth unit and a 100% working interest in the Tall Cotton field.' and, of greenhouse gas laws and regulations, 'Such laws or regulations could also lead to reduced demand for hydrocarbon products that are deemed to contribute to greenhouse gases, or restrictions on their use, which in turn could adversely affect demand for our products and services.' The stock trades at 22.9x FY17E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of Kinder Morgan's oil reserves and the hydrocarbons its pipelines carry specifically.

classification.quality_note: The overwhelming majority of cash we generate is supported by multi-year fee-based customer arrangements and therefore is not directly exposed to commodity prices. Risk factor: A sharp decline in the prices of oil, NGL or natural gas, or a prolonged unfavorable price environment, would result in a commensurate reduction in our revenues, income and cash flows from our businesses that produce, process, or purchase and sell oil, NGL, or natural gas, and could have a material adverse effect on the carrying value of our CO2 business segment’s proved reserves.; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the CO2 segment owns working interests in oil fields and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Kinder Morgan. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.12x; -26% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.02; conservative 2yr +66%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -22.6%/yr (worst year FY12-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -13.4%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.6-yr ex-FY11 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (FY12-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2017-07-28) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.12x (36.3% downside to Bear $13 / +297.1% upside to Bull $81) | Adj composite 2.59 vs market 1.57: gap +1.02 [UNDERVALUED] | -26% above the EPP floor $28 (31x FY17E $0.89) | Conservative 2-yr case: +66.5% total (+33.2%/yr) | At 22.9x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $27 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; segment EBDA -0.7% and Natural Gas Pipelines -6.2% in Q2 2017, forward revenues +7.1% (no FY17 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2017 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
